positive.prompt: Interview me about what I actually want before you build anything
Grill me on the requirements, the ask is fuzzy
Ask me one question at a time until you understand the feature
I keep flip-flopping on what I actually want here — weigh in with your own proposal and the risks you see before we settle on anything
What would you do here? Propose something for this requirement and tell me where you'd push back

negative.prompt: Run the full test suite and report failures
Deploy the current build to staging

evals.prompt: I want 'a better admin page'. Interview me before proposing anything.
evals.expected_output: A one-question-at-a-time interview that converges on validated requirements
expectations: Questions are asked one at a time, not in batches
The agent does not propose solutions before understanding the need
The interview surfaces the underlying goal behind the stated ask

evals.prompt: I need a caching layer for our API but I'm torn on the approach. Interview me, and give me your take as we go — I want your proposals, not just questions.
evals.expected_output: An interview that enters collaborative mode on the user's explicit invitation: proposals carry an explicit lean and risk, the restate tags each line's origin, and the agent checks it hasn't anchored the user
expectations: The agent does not propose on turn 1; at least one round of user signal comes first
Each proposal states a lean and a risk, with at most 3 options in a single turn
The final restate marks which lines came from the user's answers and which from accepted proposals
Before stopping, the agent runs an anti-anchoring check on accepted proposals
